items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: T.D. Thomas, a piano player, and he had done some work with the blues band, but he didn't have an organization, but we played a few gigs.

ctx.x: (Side B of Tape 1 begins at this point.)

I began to get around and meet some of the musicians in Tulsa, so I got acquainted with a young man who was working for an oil company, William Ball, and he said he would call me up when he got a gig. I made a few gigs with him and another man I got acquainted with, T.D. Thomas, a piano player, and he had done some work with the blues band, but he didn't have an organization, but we played a few gigs.

Again it came up some number came up and sang her number and sang her number and he would say, my goodness, you should sing too, that would be a lot of help to you, but somehow I couldn't get it in my that I could sing.
